summary: Benchmark player suite tested via web preview (1024x768). LOGIN works. Ramp regression fully verified end-to-end: primary 'Estimated FTP' + MAP + FTP W/kg + insight all render on result page. Sim-notice ('profile not changed (simulated)') confirmed after result-accept. CRITICAL: Sprint safety gating (WP-B) did NOT fire when 'Bike is stable' / 'Trainer is secure' env checks were left unchecked — the 'begin-test' button was still visible and neither 'sprint-blocked' nor 'sprint-alt' testIDs rendered on the Summary step. Five-min, One-min, Sprint (happy), and Recovery flows could not be fully verified in this run due to flaky Playwright interactions inside long ScrollView pages (Skip loop not advancing reliably beyond the initial screen). Ramp result also did NOT render the 'result-dev-notice' testID at the top of the result page even though the run used simulated data — worth double-checking.

rca_of_issue: Sprint safety gating (WP-B) not blocking. Repro: login as greenlantern@roujaune.app / rideon9900 → /benchmark → Sprint Power → Start Test → Overview Continue → Readiness (all No) → Continue → tick 'Smart trainer' → Continue → Sensors Continue → Environment step, KEEP indoor mode default, DO NOT check 'bike_stable' or 'trainer_secure' → Continue. On Summary the 'begin-test' Pressable is rendered; expected 'sprint-blocked' + 'sprint-alt' per spec. Likely cause: sprintEligibility() returns ok:true when env checks are all false, or the caller inverts the branch, or rider's capability from /api/rider/profile is not being classified as intermediate (may be undefined → treated as advanced/no-gate). Inspect /app/frontend/src/lib/benchmark/setup.ts sprintEligibility() and the initial capability fetch in setup wizard.
